name: Histogram
description: Luma, or R, G, B histogram bars (scope).

params.name: display
params.description: 0 luma, 1 red/green/blue overlay (additive colors), 2 red/green/blue parade (three panels side by side)

params.name: gain
params.description: Bar height factor. Linear: a bin 10x fuller than an even spread reaches the top at 1

params.name: samples
params.description: The histogram is taken from a grid of samples x samples input pixels (bounded cost, whatever the picture size)

params.name: opacity
params.description: Blend over the input picture: 1 = only the generated picture, 0 = the input unchanged
